subject: Coverage ceding proposal: Vanguard Analytics / BlueMesa integration
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@vanguard-ana.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage ceding proposal: Vanguard Analytics / BlueMesa integration

Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick follow-up from our side: BlueMesa has an active integration project with Vanguard (the implementation partner list shows overlap on six named accounts) and both sides are asking for a clear territory mapping so we avoid doubled outreach and confused procurement contacts.

High level proposal:
- Redwood will cede primary outbound ownership for four mid-market accounts to BlueMesa where they already own the integration bundle.
- Redwood retains primary ownership for two strategic accounts where we have existing renewal conversations.
- We attach a draft mapping (vanguard_mapping_v1.xlsx) and a short MOU sketch for coverage terms.

Ask: can you confirm whether Vanguard is comfortable with BlueMesa owning outreach for the listed four accounts (rows highlighted in yellow)? If yes, can procurement loop in to confirm any co-sell / reseller credit requirements?

Next steps we suggest:
1) You confirm acceptance or propose edits by Fri 10/13.
2) If accepted, legal signs the short MOU draft and we schedule a 30-min handoff between BlueMesa and our AE.

Thanks — I want to keep this lightweight and avoid surprises for the account teams.

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Partnerships & Alliances
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vanguard_mapping_v1.xlsx, mou-coverage-offer-draft.pdf

From: Sara Lin <sara@vanguard-ana.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vanguard-ana.com, Chris Ortiz <chris@bluemesa.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage ceding proposal: Vanguard Analytics / BlueMesa integration

Michael —

Appreciate the clear proposal and the spreadsheet. A few quick notes from Vanguard's side:
- We are open to BlueMesa taking primary outreach for the set of mid-market accounts, provided there is a signed co-sell agreement and a commit to our support SLA.
- Procurement needs clarity on discount treatment and whether Redwood or BlueMesa will appear on the invoice (we prefer single-invoice if possible).

I'll have procurement review the draft MOU — cc'd — and they should have initial feedback by Monday 10/15. Chris from BlueMesa, can you confirm your willingness to accept primary outreach and the proposed SLA?

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Vanguard Analytics

Team —

I pulled together a short reconciliation worksheet that lays out: current pipeline stage, ARR estimates, renewal windows, and recommended outbound owner. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cX-mapping-sheet (sheet: "Vanguard mapping v1").

Key decisions for Redwood:
- Accept BlueMesa owning outreach for accounts A-D (low churn risk, integration-first).
- Retain accounts E-F for Redwood (ongoing renewal + technical PoC).
- Offer a 10% reseller credit on any expansion closed by BlueMesa for the first 12 months as a one-time gesture.

I've attached the mapping worksheet and a redline of the MOU with those terms. If legal signs off on the MOU redline, we can route a DocuSign to Vanguard and BlueMesa for signature next week.

Marissa Cole
Senior Alliances Manager
Redwood Inference

All —

BlueMesa is willing to take primary outreach for the proposed accounts, and we accept the 10% reseller credit structure Marissa suggested. Two operational requests:
1) Please confirm the invoice flow (BlueMesa on invoice vs Redwood as single invoice). We prefer Redwood on the invoice to keep Vanguard procurement happy, but can do reseller invoicing if required.
2) Can we get a 30-min technical sync next week (propose Tue 10/16 10:00am PT) to align integration E2E and support handoff?

Soojin — tagging you for legal/contract routing and to confirm the DocuSign timeline.

Regards,
Chris Ortiz
VP Partnerships
BlueMesa Integrations
